Front: Unique Paths: {{c1::dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1]}}
Unique Paths base: {{c1::dp[0][j] = 1; dp[i][0] = 1}}
Unique Paths with obstacles: {{c1::dp[i][j] = 0 if obstacle else dp[i-1][j] + dp[i][j-1]}}
LCS recurrence: {{c1::if s1[i-1] == s2[j-1]: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1; else: dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])}}
Edit distance recurrence: {{c1::if s1[i-1] == s2[j-1]: dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1]; else: dp[i][j] = 1 + min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1], dp[i-1][j-1])}}
Edit distance operations: {{c1::dp[i-1][j] is delete, dp[i][j-1] is insert, dp[i-1][j-1] is replace}}
0/1 Knapsack: {{c1::dp[i][w] = max(dp[i-1][w], dp[i-1][w-weight[i]] + value[i])}}
0/1 Knapsack space optimized: {{c1::for w in range(W, weight[i]-1, -1): dp[w] = max(dp[w], dp[w-weight[i]] + value[i])}}
Longest palindromic substring - expand: {{c1::while left >= 0 and right < n and s[left] == s[right]: left -= 1; right += 1}}
Longest palindromic substring DP: {{c1::dp[i][j] = (s[i] == s[j]) and (j - i < 3 or dp[i+1][j-1])}}
Min path sum: {{c1::dp[i][j] = grid[i][j] + min(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])}}
Interleaving string: {{c1::dp[i][j] = (dp[i-1][j] and s1[i-1] == s3[i+j-1]) or (dp[i][j-1] and s2[j-1] == s3[i+j-1])}}
Distinct subsequences: {{c1::dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + (dp[i-1][j-1] if s[i-1] == t[j-1] else 0)}}
Best time to buy/sell with cooldown: {{c1::hold = max(hold, rest - price); sold = hold + price; rest = max(rest, sold)}}
Coin change 2 (combinations): {{c1::for coin in coins: for amount in range(coin, target+1): dp[amount] += dp[amount - coin]}}
Target sum: {{c1::convert to subset sum: find subsets with sum (target + total) / 2}}
Burst balloons: {{c1::dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][k] + dp[k][j] + nums[i]*nums[k]*nums[j] for k in range(i+1, j))}}
Regular expression matching: {{c1::if p[j-1] == '*': dp[i][j] = dp[i][j-2] or (match and dp[i-1][j])}}
